newsitem.title: CANADA: Brascan to issue C$200 mln in preferreds.
newsitem.headline: Brascan to issue C$200 mln in preferreds.

text.p: Brascan Ltd said on Thursday it plans to issue C$200 million of fixed/floating rate cumulative redeemable 1981 preferred shares, series J, on a bought deal basis at C$25 each.
The shares will yield an annual fixed cumulative preferred cash dividend of C$1.5625 per share, or 6.25 percent, payable on a quarterly basis until November 1, 2001.
Following that date, dividends will be payable monthly on a floating and adjustable basis.

On November 1, 2001 and every five years thereafter, Brascan said it will offer holders the right to convert to a new preferred series which will pay a fixed dividend of at least 80 percent of the then current five-year yield on Government of Canada bonds. Holders will be able to swap on a share-for-share basis.

Proceeds of the deal will be used to redeem Brascan's C$100 million series 1 convertible preferred shares issued in June 1996 to Hees International as part of the price paid for Brascan's increased investment in Great Lakes Power Inc.
The issue, which will be underwritten by a syndicate managed by CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc, is subject to all appropriate regulatory approvals.
